title: for a page that has every seam the pinned engine
why: The decision never exposed: an end-to-end test would wait on an attribute that is never written.

title: for a page that lacks one
why: A redraw reported as a decision against one: a test waiting for never would read the count before the redraw was asked.

title: is nothing until the page has said what it has
why: The decision said before it is made: a test waiting for it would read the count too soon, which is the sleep over again.

title: says never where the screen settled on leaving the page
why: The section not saying it: the state is right and nothing a test can read shows it.

title: has no attribute before the decision
why: The attribute present before the decision, as never: every wait on it would pass at once.

title: renders cells 02 and 03 alone for what the opening redrew
why: The decision's slice following the opening's fields: the map renders for a job id and a seam list it does not read.

title: renders the map alone for the decision it settled on
why: The decision in the opening's slice: cells 02 and 03 render for it, though only the map reads it.

find:
if (now.kind === 'wait') return
    redrawSettled.current = true
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- the decision, and below it the job a redraw just started: known only as they are made
    setOnOpen(now.kind)
replace:
// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- the decision, and below it the job a redraw just started: known only as they are made
    setOnOpen(now.kind)
    if (now.kind === 'wait') return
    redrawSettled.current = true
title: stays nothing while the decision waits
why: The signal given before the decision is made: a test waiting on it would read the count while the screen is still holding off.

title: does not ask again for a redraw that failed
why: The screen never settled: a redraw that fails leaves what asked for it true again, and it is asked for again, and again.
